approval.owner: The project owner, as recorded in the decision log
approval.decisionEntry: 13 Oct 2026 — Roomy proportions and the kit unit are approved within a limited scope.
approval.scope: Only K = H/8 and the nine recorded roomy ratios. The preserved image witnesses that selected package; it does not approve all depicted materials, assets, counts, clearances or camera settings.

approvedKitUnit.meaning: Canonical nominal standing height; posed limbs, shoes and hair can extend or shorten projected silhouette bounds.

parameterDefinitions.headRatio: Hair-free head ellipsoid height divided by canonical standing H; reference observations include hair, so this is a deliberate readable-head choice.
parameterDefinitions.shoulderRatio: Canonical torso/shoulder width parameter divided by H, before the build multiplier, shaped jacket profile and sleeve/pose envelope; not a measured full silhouette width.
parameterDefinitions.worktopRatio: Top working surface elevation divided by H. .50/.54 are post-first design choices above the moods cabinet projected estimates.
parameterDefinitions.counterRadiusRatio: Outer circular counter lip radius divided by H; furniture footprint excludes chair/figure/action clearance.
parameterDefinitions.stationWidthRatio: Nominal outer-lip chord between paired radial support-frame centre lines, divided by H. Frame angles are plus/minus asin(width / (2 * counterRadius)). Actual clear width is smaller by frame thickness; this is not an exact unobstructed knee or work envelope.
parameterDefinitions.stationDepthRatio: Nominal radial distance from the outer lip to the inner counter-body boundary, divided by H. The worktop adds a .035H inner overhang, so its full surface depth is this value plus .035H; equipment and frame clearances are separate.
parameterDefinitions.postPitchRatio: Neighboring post floor-center spacing divided by H.
parameterDefinitions.figureRadiusRatio: Standing figure stance center radius from post center, divided by H. Both candidates leave .17H from outer lip.
parameterDefinitions.monitorCrownRatio: Top of the central monitor cluster divided by H.

notApproved: Skin, hair and clothing materials, including their current semantic palette bindings.
Figure and asset design, including silhouettes, props, furniture construction and animation.
The 36-figure population, post count and specific crowd distribution.
Physical units or conversion to metres.
Additional geometry dimensions, final clearances, collision envelopes, camera framing and scale.
Newly exposed underside colour assignments, interface and renderer or Stage 0 acceptance.

provenance.selectionMeaning: Option 1 is the middle column beside the picked reference; Option 2 was the compact alternative. Raw candidate and review statuses retain their pre-selection meaning.

captureEvidence.approvalScope: Reproduction metadata only. No palette, camera, population, final asset or physical-scale approval is implied.
captureEvidence.fontManifestMeaning: Empty wordless-canvas manifest; no interface fonts or glyphs are certified.

materialScope: Prior day/night approvals remain exactly as recorded in those briefs. This proportion pick does not approve diagnostic skin, hair, shirt, trouser or new underside assignments.
